snippet.title: Mutasmagoria - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4268040/Mutasmagoria/

Mutasmagoria is a new narrative puzzle adventure. Play as a veterinarian just starting work at a zoo in an alien world whose evolutionary paths diverged greatly from our own. Make effective use of your day, as all time spent comes as a trade-off, and every choice has a consequence.
